sources.text: December 17th, 2022 - Check engine light came on with an onstar message to have my engine/transmission system serviced within 7 days.   Dealership replaced fuel pump module on December 23rd.   Drove the car to a basketball game that evening (14 miles) and check engine light came back on with same onstar message.   Took car to dealership on January 3rd (due to holiday, didn't drive vehicle after check engine light came on).  Dealership advised it was a low battery.  So battery was replaced and advised we should come get the car.  When they were driving the car from the back of the lot to the front of the lot - the check engine light came on again.  They called us to tell us not to come get the car that they found a new code issue.  They advised they would call us tomorrow.
